title: Reliable Annotations with Less Effort: Evaluating LLM-Human Collaboration in Search Clarifications
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on evaluating LLM performance in the technical task of search clarification annotation.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
